name: scenescout
description: Exploratory UI testing: Claude explores a running web app like a curious user, finds what is broken or confusing, and writes a coverage-checked report.
long_description:
SceneScout gives Claude a real browser to test a web app with. Ask it to test an address, for example http://localhost:3000, and it visits the pages, tries the forms and buttons, notes what is broken or confusing, and writes a report.

By default a write policy at the network layer blocks edits and deletions, while ordinary form submissions go through. For a site that holds real data, ask it to observe only: then nothing but reads leaves the page.

The test browser downloads on first use: the first test fetches it once (about 200 MB) and carries on. If that download fails, SceneScout says why and gives the command to run by hand: `npx -y scenescout install --browser-only`.
